description: Swiss AHV/AVS old-age pension (1st pillar): the 13th AHV pension (first paid December 2026, one twelfth of the year's old-age pensions, automatic, old-age pensions only, not counted for supplementary benefits), minimum and maximum pension and couples cap for 2026 and 2027, reference age and AHV 21 transition supplements, early withdrawal reductions and deferral supplements, contribution rates, how to apply, and old-age pensions and average pension per canton. Every value carries its official source (BSV, ahv-iv.ch leaflets, AHVG/AHVV). Optional monthly_pension and months return the 13th pension amount.

canton.description: 2-letter abbreviation, optional: that canton's pension statistics

monthly_pension.description: monthly old-age pension in CHF, optional

months.description: months with an old-age pension in the year, 1 to 12, default 12

name: ahv_pension
